rationale: Both Dhanush and Sanjar are building in robotics with complementary focuses—Dhanush's expertise in robot perception and ROS architecture at xLogic Labs pairs well with Sanjar's humanoid robotics and manipulation work at Humanola Inc. They share core technical foundations in Python and C++, and their combined experience across full-stack robotics development and CEO-level execution creates potential for knowledge exchange on scaling robotics solutions.
intro_message: Dhanush Baktha, meet Sanjar Atamuradov — you're both building robotics companies with overlapping technical stacks (Python, C++) and complementary specializations in perception and humanoid manipulation.
